name: Nominal Baseline (ISS Cupola Rest)
purpose: Establish normative resting physiological telemetry during calm Earth observation in the ISS Cupola module.
dataStatus: Synthetic demonstration dataset informed by published aerospace medicine literature (NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1 §4.1; Hughson et al. 2018). No raw LSDA-0042 records are imported into this prototype.
playbackTrajectory: Micro-fluctuations within healthy resting autonomic bounds (HR 70-74 bpm, SpO2 98.9-99.1%).
rationale: Serves as the scientific control state. Proves that anomaly detectors remain silent during healthy baseline telemetry.
expectedResult: All status indicators display NOMINAL, OPTIMAL, and REGULAR. Zero false-positive alerts.
actualResult: PASSED - Verified clean nominal baseline across 60 rows with 0 triggered alerts.

name: EVA Spacewalk Hypoxia Leak
purpose: Simulate life-support breathing gas failure or micro-puncture during Extravehicular Activity.
dataStatus: Synthetic demonstration dataset modeling suit breathing gas micro-puncture informed by NASA EVA flight surgeon emergency protocols. No raw flight incident records are imported.
playbackTrajectory: At t=00:06, SpO2 drops sharply from 99.2% to 86.4%. Compensatory HR climbs to 118 bpm; RR elevates to 24 br/min.
rationale: Arterial desaturation stimulates peripheral carotid chemoreceptors, triggering autonomic tachycardia and compensatory hyperventilation.
scientificReferences: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 Rev F §6.2.1.2 (Ambient Inspired pO2 limits: 19.5–23.1 kPa); FAA Civil Aerospace Medical Institute Hypoxia Training Concepts (general physiology context); Guyton & Hall Medical Physiology §41.
rulesTriggered: Rule CDSS-O2-01: Acute Arterial Hypoxemia (SpO2 < 92%); Rule CDSS-HR-01: Compensatory Tachycardia (HR > 115 bpm).
expectedResult: Immediate CRITICAL alert banner with prototype EVA hypoxia alert, illustrative suit oxygen check steps, and cautious escalation guidance to verify sensors and notify flight surgeons per mission flight rules.
actualResult: PASSED - Alerts fire reliably at t=00:06 with full explainability trace and protocolized next steps.

name: ARED Heavy Resistive Workout
purpose: Demonstrate physiological response to 380 lbs resistive loading on the Advanced Resistive Exercise Device.
dataStatus: Synthetic demonstration dataset modeling physiological resistive workout response informed by published ASCR ARED exercise studies (English et al. 2020).
playbackTrajectory: Heavy loading drives HR progressively to 154 bpm and RR to 32 br/min. SpO2 remains stable (97.8-98.4%); core temp rises to 37.6°C.
rationale: High-workload exertional response. Software must NOT misclassify benign exercise tachycardia as cardiac arrest or pathological hypoxemia.
scientificReferences: English et al., 'High-intensity exercise preserves muscle mass in spaceflight,' NPJ Microgravity, 2020; NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1 §4.2.
rulesTriggered: Rule CDSS-EXER-01: High-Workload Exertional Tachycardia (Concordant with stable SpO2).
expectedResult: Informational status tag; no false critical alarms. Workout logged toward Mission Readiness Pillar #1.
actualResult: PASSED - Verified stable aerobic classification without false arrhythmia alarms.

name: Deep Space Solar Radiation Flare (SPE)
purpose: Simulate acute high-energy proton flux from a coronal mass ejection during Mars transit.
dataStatus: Synthetic demonstration dataset modeling solar particle event radiation flux informed by NASA SRAG and MSL-RAD published measurements (Cucinotta et al. 2013).
playbackTrajectory: At t=00:08, external dosimeter rate spikes from 0.44 mSv/day to 18.5 mSv/day; acute sympathetic anxiety raises HR to 98 bpm.
rationale: High-Z and solar energetic proton flux threatens acute radiation syndrome; requires prompt relocation to polyethylene storm shelter.
scientificReferences: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1 §4.4; Cucinotta et al., 'Space radiation cancer risk projections,' NASA/TP-2013-217375.
rulesTriggered: Rule CDSS-RAD-01: Critical Cosmic Radiation Flux (> 5.0 mSv/day).
expectedResult: CRITICAL alert, illustrative storm shelter guidance per mission flight rules, and radiation dosimeter log update.
actualResult: PASSED - Solar storm flare alert triggers at threshold with protocolized shielding guidance.

name: SANS Cephalad Fluid Shift & LBNP Recovery
purpose: Model spaceflight-associated ocular changes caused by sustained microgravity venous engorgement.
dataStatus: Synthetic demonstration dataset modeling spaceflight cephalad fluid redistribution and optic nerve sheath diameter changes informed by NASA HRP SANS evidence reports and Lee et al. (2020).
playbackTrajectory: Simulated ONSD rises to 5.9 mm (nominal < 5.8 mm). Following simulated LBNP countermeasure initiation, ONSD stabilizes to 5.2 mm.
rationale: Absence of hydrostatic column moves ~1.5-2.0 L of venous fluid cranial, expanding retrobulbar optic nerve sheath.
scientificReferences: Lee et al., 'Spaceflight-associated neuro-ocular syndrome,' NPJ Microgravity, 2020; Hargens et al., Front Physiol, 2021.
rulesTriggered: Rule CDSS-SANS-01: Microgravity Cephalad Redistribution / ONSD Expansion (> 5.8 mm).
expectedResult: WARNING alert, protocolized LBNP countermeasure guidance, ophthalmic monitoring checklist.
actualResult: PASSED - Ocular warning alerts fire and successfully link to LBNP countermeasure guidance.

name: Synthetic Cardiac Arrhythmia Example (Paroxysmal VT)
purpose: Simulate acute cardiac conduction disturbance (paroxysmal ventricular tachycardia) during spaceflight.
dataStatus: Synthetic arrhythmia-inspired demonstration dataset modeling paroxysmal ventricular tachycardia inspired by morphological principles in PhysioNet MIT-BIH research waveforms (#208). No raw MIT-BIH files are imported into this prototype.
playbackTrajectory: At t=00:07, sudden burst of wide-complex ventricular tachycardia drives instantaneous HR to 168 bpm, SpO2 dips to 94.1%.
rationale: Validates CDSS rhythm detection: distinguishes non-exertional sudden tachycardia with distorted QRS from physical exercise.
scientificReferences: PhysioNet MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database (#208 research reference); NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1 §4.1; Hughson et al. (2018).
rulesTriggered: Rule CDSS-CARD-02: Paroxysmal Ventricular Tachyarrhythmia / QRS Morphology Abnormality.
expectedResult: Immediate CRITICAL alert, illustrative cardiac monitoring checklist, and telemetry priority packet transmission to flight surgeons.
actualResult: PASSED - Arrhythmia event triggers instant critical warning with ECG vector annotation.
